title: App shell: TanStack Start; the Barkpark token lives only in server functions
evidence: app/src/server/barkpark.ts (server-only; token from .env or the owner's bp login); app/src/chat/api.ts loadChat/startChat/sendMessage; /api/chat/$id/events passes Barkpark's stream through. Browser bundle has no token code (build checked). A real turn ran end to end through the app on 2026-11-11 (T6). Only BarkBot's own conversations open (task-26a1a137b955ef3b): the token can open any session id, so every door that takes one (the two /api/chat/$id routes and sendMessage, uploadAttachment, answerApproval, answerQuestion) opens with a guard from app/src/server/own-session.ts, which returns only for a registered-host session on one of the caller's own computers that a bot record names or this server made (startChat). Anything else, or a read that fails, is refused: a route's requireOwnSessionRoute throws a 404 whose body is only the NOT_OWN line, and a server function's requireOwnSessionFn throws an Error(NOT_OWN), so it sends nothing and the page keeps the words in the box with that line (a thrown Response reaches the page as {}, which read as sent: rev299 round 2 on #320). scripts/lib/own-session.mjs: 9 rules, 3 of them through the real composer. Every other door is on the check's open list with its reason (loadChat, createBot, computerOnline, startChat, renameBot, the fleet stream, Gate B's dev routes). When no bot record could be saved (the Main Bot's move-in failed or waits), loadChat opens no conversation: one picked then would be in no record, so its doors would refuse it; the next message starts one (startChat), which opens. Known misses, accepted: after a restart, a conversation whose bot record was not saved (kept: false) does not open until its record is saved; a conversation on a revoked computer does not open (Barkpark's list leaves revoked computers out); the move-in adopts the newest folderless conversation on our computer, which can be a workspace-mate's, and once saved in the Main Bot's record it is trusted (task-7baccaa5734a64bd, needs task-7efaf895e8bc88e4); startChat makes a conversation on whatever computer the page names, so a page can name a workspace-mate's computer from our workspace's list and then drive it: our list is workspace-wide and only Barkpark can tell whose computer it is (rev299's C7c on #320; task-7baccaa5734a64bd, beside the move-in). Barkpark does not record who made a session; task-7efaf895e8bc88e4 would.
gate: vite build fails if browser code imports server/barkpark (vite.config.ts); npm run turn:live (owner-run: needs the owner's Barkpark login and the enrolled Mac online; not in land or CI). Record: parity/live/turn.json. Seen to fail both ways on 2026-11-11: no computer by that name, and the host stopped (no reply in 90 s). npm run check 'own session', deny by default (scripts/lib/session-doors.mjs): it reads every file under app/ but node_modules and generated output; every server function opens with await requireOwnSessionFn(…) and every method handler of every server route with await requireOwnSessionRoute(…), or is on the open list with a reason of 10 characters or more; createServerFn may appear only as the plain named import from @tanstack/react-start and a direct call; anything else, and anything the scan cannot read, reds (37 made-up cases, rev299's planted doors from both rounds among them).
